ERR_WATCH_NOT_READ.message: Watch {id} request is not a read
ERR_WATCH_NOT_READ.hint: Only commands with dir CMD_DIR_READ (0) can be watched.

ERR_WATCH_BAD_ARG.hint: Check id (1..255), period (>= 1), trigger, owner peer id and read length.

ERR_WATCH_FULL.hint: Remove an unused watch first or raise CONFIG_SYS_WATCH_MAX / CONFIG_SYS_WATCH_CLIENT_MAX.

ERR_WATCH_NO_VALUE.message: No cached watch value from board {board} yet

ERR_WATCH_STALE.message: Cached watch value from board {board} is stale ({age_ms} ms old)
